name: Sasuke Aomine
source: Takano's youngest brother. He is madly in love with the protagonist. In fact, he has loved her ever since he saw her for the first time, but because of his brother he couldn't bring himself to confess to her. He has waited a whole year after his brother's death to come clean with her on the topic. Now, he will do anything to make her fall in love with him.
